summary.text: Patrick Connick is a Republican member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 8 (Jefferson and Plaquemines parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official Senate member page. Patrick Connick chairs the Transportation, Highways and Public Works Committee.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as Archbishop Shaw High School, 1979; Loyola University New Orleans, B.A., 1983; Loyola University Law School, J.D., 1993.

The page lists committee assignments including Transportation, Highways and Public Works (chair), Commerce, Consumer Protection and International Affairs, Environmental Quality, Revenue and Fiscal Affairs, Natural Resources (ex officio), the Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay and the Senate Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
